commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the frontend, publish the desktop app and bundle distributables

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Run the frontend dev server and the desktop app with hot reload

commands.name: info
commands.description:
Print environment, toolchain and manifest diagnostics
--help, -h       Show this help
--version, -V    Print the CLI version

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a new application from the tarui-app template

options.name: --config
options.description:
Path to tarui.app.json (default: ./tarui.app.json)
'tarui init' options:
<name>             Application name (e.g. tarui init my-app)

options.name: --manager
options.description: Package manager to install frontend deps (default: pnpm)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Target directory (default: ./<name>)
Scaffold target directory (default: current directory)
'tarui dev' options:

options.name: --local
options.description:
Reference a local Tarui source tree instead of published packages
'tarui plugin' options:
init <name>        Scaffold a plugin skeleton (e.g. tarui plugin init store)
pack               Pre-flight checks before packaging a plugin

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Use 'dotnet run' instead of 'dotnet watch run'

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Print child process command lines
'tarui build' options:

options.name: --rid
options.description: Runtime identifier, e.g. win-x64 (default: current platform)

options.name: --bundle
options.description: Bundle targets to produce, e.g. zip,msix (default: manifest bundle.targets)
